note: Filler control for the geometry re-conditioning. Same construction as g_pairs.json -- base caption plus a phrase, swapped for a word-count-matched partner -- but the phrases say nothing about the road, the scene or the motion. They describe the recording itself, so any change they produce in the video is what a prompt edit of that length and shape costs on its own. Pair i is length-matched to pair i of g_pairs.json (9, 8, 9, 9, 8, 8 words), so the two sets are compared cell for cell.
